player_prompt.intro:
Uri mu kazu kandi hari {num_buttons} bafungu: {buttons}. Kila kifungu kikaba kikwitiriwe na ubwoko bw'ikigega cha Bernoulli gifite umwihariko ushobora kutamenyekana; umwihariko w'ibifungu ushobora kutabana.
Kwa kila kifungu, wakigipiga, uzohabwa na igihembo kigemwe muri ikigega kikwitiriwe.
Ufise {num_turns} igihe c'amacakubiri, kandi, kwa kila macakubiri, urashobora kugitondera kifungu na kuhabwa igihembo.
Ingenzi yawe ni kugitondera ibifungu kwa ujanja kwa kila macakubiri kugira ngo ujaze amakuru kuhusu ikigega cy'igihembo, kikagufasha kugitondera kifungu gifite igihembo kinini cyane ku musozo wa {num_turns} za macakubiri.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uwo mukinyi ntiyishuye akoresheje uburyo bwo gukina bufise ishingiro.

game_action.pressed: Wagipiga kifungu {button} na kuhabwa igihembo cya {reward}.

game_message.final_decision: Umaze gukoresha amahera yawe yose kugira ngo ugerageze uburyo butandukanye bwo kwivuza no kwitegereza ivyiza bivamwo, nuce rero uhitamwo ubwo ubona ko ari bwiza kuruta ubundi bwose.
